def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Define beam dimensions
    width = 0.2
    height = 0.3
    density = 500.0
    
    # Left strip beams (x=12.5)
    left_beams = []
    # Lower band: y=1.0, 1.5, 2.0
    for y in [1.0, 1.5, 2.0]:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=width, height=height, density=density)
        left_beams.append(beam)
    # Middle band: y=3.0, 3.5, 4.0
    for y in [3.0, 3.5, 4.0]:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=width, height=height, density=density)
        left_beams.append(beam)
    # Upper band: y=5.0, 5.5, 6.0
    for y in [5.0, 5.5, 6.0]:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=width, height=height, density=density)
        left_beams.append(beam)
    
    # Middle strip beam (x=13.0, y=3.5)
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.0, y=3.5, width=width, height=height, density=density)
    
    # Right strip beams (x=13.5)
    right_beams = []
    # Middle band: y=3.5
    beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.5, y=3.5, width=width, height=height, density=density)
    right_beams.append(beam)
    # Upper band: y=6.0
    beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.5, y=6.0, width=width, height=height, density=density)
    right_beams.append(beam)
    
    # Connect left beams to middle beam
    for beam in left_beams[3:6]:  # Middle band beams
        anchor_x = (beam.position.x + middle_beam.position.x) / 2
        anchor_y = (beam.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(beam, middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect right beams to middle beam
    anchor_x = (right_beams[0].position.x + middle_beam.position.x) / 2
    anchor_y = (right_beams[0].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[0], middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect right upper beam to right middle beam
    anchor_x = (right_beams[1].position.x + right_beams[0].position.x) / 2
    anchor_y = (right_beams[1].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], right_beams[0], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect left beams vertically
    for i in range(len(left_beams) - 1):
        anchor_x = (left_beams[i].position.x + left_beams[i+1].position.x) / 2
        anchor_y = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i+1].position.y) / 2
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i+1], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    return left_beams + [middle_beam] + right_beams
